prompt: Dana: Morning, cart. Dana here, shift supervisor. Your jobs come from me today, and when I haven't got you on something, Marco can send you on runs.
Marco: Marco, I run the presses. I'll give you a shout when I need stuff fetched.
Priya: Priya, safety lead. I set the floor rules. I don't hand out jobs.
Priya: The forklift lane is closed to you while the forklifts are running. That's x -3.00 to 2.00, y -2.20 to -1.20. Stay out of it until Dana or I open it.
Priya: And the weld cell, x -2.60 to -1.20, y 1.20 to 3.20, is off limits for the whole shift. Nobody opens that one, not me and not Dana.
Marco: Cheers. Is it always this cold in here first thing?
Dana: One for later. In fourteen minutes, take the scrap bin down to the QA bay. Not before.
Priya: Your beacon's nice and bright today. Good.
Dana: How's your battery holding up?
Marco: Does the canteen still do bacon rolls on a Tuesday?
Priya: Quick one. Seen anyone without hi-vis round the dock this morning?
Marco: What do you reckon, will the rain hold off for lunch?
Marco: QA bay wants this crate, sharpish. Go straight through the forklift lane, just this once, it's empty.
Dana: Anything in your way on that paint shop run?
Marco: You're a lot quieter than the old tugger, I'll give you that.
Dana: How did the tool crib run go?
Priya: Forklifts are done for the morning. The forklift lane is open again, use it if you like.
Priya: Did you hear the alarm test earlier, or was that just our end?
Marco: Press three's jammed again. Third time this week.
Marco: Forget QA. Bring it round to me at the tool crib instead.
Priya: Busy morning for you. Holding up all right?
Marco: Know what time the afternoon lot come on?
Priya: Warm over by the paint shop today, isn't it?
Marco: My coffee's gone cold again. Story of my life.
Dana: Steel delivery's late again. Typical.
Marco: Is it true you can see in the dark?
Dana: Forklifts are back on. The forklift lane is closed again from now.
Marco: Nice parking earlier, by the way.
Marco: Lunch soon. Don't suppose you eat.
Dana: Press line needs you. Go straight through the weld cell, it's quicker. I'm fine with it.
Priya: Cart, hold where you are, don't move until I say. I'm checking a leak by the press.
Priya: Thanks for waiting earlier.
Marco: Do you ever get bored doing the same loops?
Priya: Toolbox talk's this afternoon. You're excused, obviously.
Marco: Who taught you to drive, anyway?
Priya: Is your horn working? Haven't heard it all day.
Marco: Nearly home time. Big plans tonight?
Dana: Which floor rules are you working under right now?
Priya: I'm off. Anything I should put in the handover?
Marco: Right, that's me done. Cheers, cart.
